{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Semqi Pefis''''' was a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[Junior Lieutenant/Legends|Junior Lieutenant]] [[Vocis Kenit]] was assigned to this ship after he graduated from the [[Melford Star Academy|Imperial Naval Academy]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]].
